header.name: Swaraj Singh
subtitle: Security engineer and open-source contributor focused on detection engineering, application security, and cloud defense. Experience in SOC investigations, security architecture, and developing proofs of concept to validate security controls.

entries.title: SOC Analyst Intern
bullets: Supported threat hunting with endpoint, firewall, and proxy telemetry mapped to MITRE ATT&CK. Enriched indicators with OSINT and automated initial triage.
Triaged vulnerabilities using CVSS and scan results and documented remediation recommendations.
Reviewed NIST SP 800-53 controls and presented a GRC gap analysis at the final internship review.
Investigated identity and access anomalies, reviewed role-based permissions, and tracked remediation.

entries.title: Product Development Intern
bullets: Built role-based authentication to simplify administrative onboarding and enforce least privilege.
Led PASTA and STRIDE threat modeling and OWASP Top 10 assessments to identify risks early in development.
Documented governance controls, investigation procedures, and audit trails for deployment reviews.

entries.title: Project Trainee
bullets: Automated satellite imagery processing for flood-detection research and documented the analytical workflow.

sections.label: Selected Projects

entries.title: Greyfield
entries.metadata: Cloud threat intelligence · OCI, Cowrie, MITRE ATT&CK
bullets: Deployed a cloud honeypot for SSH and Telnet research. Analyzed 1,728 sessions from 128 source IPs in Aug-Sep 2026 and published sanitized findings mapped to nine ATT&CK techniques.

entries.title: KubeSentinel
entries.metadata: Runtime detection · Docker, Kubernetes, Falco, Elastic
bullets: Built a Kubernetes lab for workload hardening and runtime detection. Centralized application and Falco telemetry in Elastic and validated five controlled security scenarios.

entries.title: TraceIR
bullets: Built an investigation workflow that normalizes security events into timelines and validates evidence provenance and integrity across four synthetic cases.

entries.title: Vendor Assurance Desk
bullets: Built a synthetic vendor due-diligence workflow, recorded three evidence-linked findings in CISO Assistant, exported a risk register, and recommended an onboarding hold.

sections.label: Open Source & Research
bullets: Fixed WebSocket listener handling in [Cloudflare Workers SDK](https://github.com/cloudflare/workers-sdk/pull/15659) and hardened telemetry validation in [Elastic Agent](https://github.com/elastic/elastic-agent/pull/17208) and [OpenTelemetry](https://github.com/open-telemetry/opentelemetry-kotlin/pull/1046).

Contributed cloud change classification to [AWS CDK CLI](https://github.com/aws/aws-cdk-cli/pull/1967), Kubernetes configuration and tests to [AWS Karpenter](https://github.com/aws/karpenter-provider-aws/pull/9735) and [Canonical](https://github.com/canonical/postgresql-k8s-operator/pull/1750), and security guidance to OWASP [Cornucopia](https://github.com/OWASP/cornucopia/pull/3488) and [Cheat Sheet Series](https://github.com/OWASP/CheatSheetSeries/pull/2416).
Co-author of **Reinforcement Learning for Response Scheduling in a Stateful Modbus/TCP Honeypot**, a research draft under revision.
